findings.evidence: `Continuation.lean:232-238` defines the general `eventuallyEq`; `GlobalBranch.lean:141-145` proves the new declaration by exactly one application of it, and `rg` finds uses only at `GlobalBranch.lean:215,217`.
findings.fix: Remove the wrapper and invoke `hf.eventuallyEq ... isPreconnected_univ (mem_univ 0) (mem_univ 1) ...` directly at those two call sites, or keep the specialization private if local readability warrants it.
findings.issue: `IsAnalyticContinuationAlong.eventuallyEq_one` is a thin restatement of the existing public `IsAnalyticContinuationAlong.eventuallyEq`, specialized to `s = univ`, `a = 0`, and `b = 1`; its only consumers are lines 215 and 217 in this file.

summary: The PR adds new global-branch material, but includes one unnecessary public specialization of an existing uniqueness theorem.
